; hideSidebarGuides v0.1.0
; Hides the "Guides" (quickHelp) entry in the xochitl navigator sidebar. The
; onboarding tour is a one-time read; the row costs a permanent slot in a short
; list. Standalone mod — no shared state with any other qmd, adds no identifiers.
;
; HIDE, NOT DELETE. Sidebar.qml:22 declares
;   navigationModel: [filterMyFiles, ..., quickHelp, settingsButton]
; which references quickHelp BY ID. REMOVE-ing the IconButton leaves that array
; pointing at a dead id and takes the whole sidebar down with it. The id must
; stay resolvable, so the element stays and only its visibility flips.
;
; `visible` is INSERTed, not REPLACEd: stock quickHelp never ASSIGNS visible, it
; only READS it (`enabled: visible`, :510). qmldiff's REPLACE is LOCATE+REMOVE+
; INSERT and hard-fails when the node is absent — `REPLACE visible WITH {...}`
; panics with "Cannot LOCATE [visible]" (verified against the 3.27 dump).
; Layout.preferredHeight DOES exist in stock (:514), so that one is a REPLACE.
;
; No separate `enabled` edit is needed: stock `enabled: visible` collapses to
; false on its own, so the hidden row is also unreachable by keyboard/tab
; activation despite still sitting in navigationModel.
;
; Layout.preferredHeight: 0 is belt-and-braces — QQuickLayout already skips
; !visible children when laying out a ColumnLayout, so the row reserves no space
; either way. Kept because it states the intent at zero cost.
;
; The 2px separator Item above quickHelp (:497-505) is deliberately left alone;
; with Guides hidden it sits directly above Settings, which is where a divider
; belongs anyway. Visual confirmation on device is deferred.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler > ColumnLayout#filterColumn > IconButton#quickHelp
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            visible: false
        }
        REPLACE Layout.preferredHeight WITH {
            Layout.preferredHeight: 0
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
